metadata.title: Sentinel-IPAbuse-TriageAndBlock
metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel playbook that, on each incident, autonomously server-side clones the OPSLSY-75376 Technical change (via CloneIssueDetails.jspa, so the Insight/Assets Affected item is carried intact), finds the new key by JQL search, overrides summary/description/dates, walks the change to Implementation, enriches the incident IPs against AbuseIPDB, appends the kept IPs to a static-site blocklist blob, attaches the CSV report, then walks the change to Closed with resolution Successful. No human approval and no CLOPSSEC ticket. On an AbuseIPDB outage the same change is still driven to Closed with the raw (un-enriched) IP list attached. The Logic App's system-assigned managed identity requires: Microsoft Sentinel Responder on the workspace, Key Vault Secrets User on the Key Vault, and Storage Blob Data Contributor on the blocklist storage account.
prerequisites: Key Vault secret '<JiraKeyVaultSecretName>' holding the Trackspace service account password.
Storage account hosting the blocklist with $web/index.html present (static website enabled).
AzureSentinel and KeyVault API connections (this template creates them if absent).

OMS-owned AbuseIPDB API connection 'abuseipdb-connection-AbuseIPDB-EnrichIncidentByIPInfo' in resource group LSY_WEUR_ITCS_PRD_OMS_RG_001 already authorised; this template does not create or modify it.
metadata.author: TI handling automation

metadata.description: Name for the Logic App and its API connections. Must match the deployed Logic App ('TI-handler') so a default deploy updates the existing playbook in place rather than spinning up a second parallel one with a fresh managed identity.
Azure region for the Logic App. Must match the existing Sentinel/Key Vault region.
Name of the Key Vault holding the Trackspace service account password.
Trackspace base URL (also the host for the CloneIssueDetails.jspa servlet). Production is https://trackspace.lhsystems.com; use https://int-trackspace.lhsystems.com for the INT environment.
Trackspace service account username (Basic auth).
Key Vault secret name storing the Trackspace password.
Project the change is raised in; also used in the find-clone-by-search JQL.
Template Technical change that is server-side cloned each run (carries the Insight/Assets Affected item customfield_24305, which cannot be set via REST). Its numeric id is resolved at runtime.
ARM resource id of the Microsoft Sentinel (Log Analytics) workspace whose incidents are managed. Used by the MI-authenticated management REST call that finds the two source incidents.
api-version for the Microsoft.SecurityInsights incidents list call.
Prefix of the network-session IoC incident title (the middle segment is the dynamic IP).
Suffix of the network-session IoC incident title.
Exact title of the second source incident.
Sentinel classification (ClassificationAndReason) applied when the source incidents are closed on the success path.
Issue-type name for the run-record sub-task created on the clone before any technical change (also satisfies the Start-implementation "has sub-task" validator).
Jira priority (by name) set on the run-record Operation sub-task.
Jira login the run-record sub-task is assigned to (the Sentinel service account).
Target status/transition the run-record sub-task moves to on a successful run (matched against transition name OR target status).
Target status/transition the run-record sub-task moves to on a failed or fallback run (matched against transition name OR target status).

Jira resolution set on the run-record sub-task when it moves to the success status (Resolved). Sent only if that transition's screen carries a resolution field; matched (case-insensitive) against the transition's allowed resolutions, falling back to the first allowed value so an invalid default is never used.
Jira login the main OPSLSY change ticket is assigned to (SecOps) for manual review at Post-implementation review.
First walk target status after clone. Matched case-insensitively as a substring of each transition's target status name.
Second walk target; the ticket sits here while enrichment + blocklist write run.
Third walk target; resolution + actual start/finish are set on this transition.
Final walk target. Matched case-insensitively as a substring of the transition's target status name; statusCategory 'done' is also accepted.
Storage account hosting the blocklist.
Inclusive lower bound for AbuseIPDB totalReports. IPs with fewer reports are dropped.
ISP names (lower-case) whose IPs are always dropped, even if totalReports >= MinReports.

inputs.summary: Block malicious/suspicious IPs reported by Microsoft Sentinel Threat Intelligence - @{formatDateTime(outputs('Capture_Run_Start'), 'yyyy.MM.dd')}

runError.message: CloneIssueDetails.jspa returned status @{coalesce(outputs('Clone_OPSLSY_Change')?['statusCode'], 'none')}; expected 2xx/3xx (302 is the normal async-clone redirect and is treated as success).

queries.jql: project = @{parameters('JiraProjectKey')} AND issuetype = "Technical change" AND reporter = @{parameters('JIRAUserName')} AND created >= -10m ORDER BY created DESC

runError.message: Clone not found by search within the polling window (reporter + created >= run start). The clone may not have indexed in time, or the JQL/permissions changed.

fields.description:
*GOAL:* Block suspicious/malicious IPs maked by Microsoft Sentinel Threat Intelligence
*Root-cause:* Several Sentinel alert created indicating there are communication with these IPs.
*Time frame:* in optimal case approximately 5 minutes
*Accurate start time:* @{outputs('Compute_Run_Times')['displayStart']}
*Accurate finish time:* @{outputs('Compute_Run_Times')['displayFinish']}
*Affected Service:* Palo Alto Fws
*Impact:* Not expected.
*Tested:* OPSLSY-37786
*Communicate and contact:* LSYH, BUD NETOPS and LSYH, BUD SECOPS
*Rollback:* Remove IP(s) that cause problem from External dynamic deny rule named - Sentinel_Threat_Intelligence_IPs

Blocked IPs can be found in the attachment.
Record of the TI-handler automation run. Resolved = the run completed successfully; On Hold = the run failed or needs manual intervention. Logic App run id: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']}
